steps.title: Prepare Magnetic Stand
steps.instruction: Prepare the magnetic stand for AMPure XP beads by using hot glue to fix one magnet each in the north-south direction between two holes under the PCR rack.

steps.title: Collect and Prepare Samples
steps.instruction: Collect 2 x 2 mL of samples from daily feed waste using a cut-off pipette tip to transfer both liquid and solid contents.

substeps.instruction: Separate solids from liquid by centrifugation at 10000 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Freeze the pellet at -80 °C until further processing.

steps.title: Cell Lysis and DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Process the frozen pellets to extract nucleic acids.

substeps.instruction: Thaw pellets on ice and add 0.3 g of 0.1 mm beads and 0.1 g of 0.5 mm beads.
Add 1.5 µL of DNase-free RNase and incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes.
Homogenize the pellets using a bead beater at maximum speed for 3 minutes.
Add 200 µL of 10 M NH4CH3COO (use 260 µL if the optional step was carried out), mix well, and incubate on ice for 5 minutes.
Transfer the supernatant to a new Eppendorf tube. (Optional: Add another 300 µL lysis buffer to the pellet and repeat steps 7-10 if needed).
Centrifuge at 16000 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.
Incubate at 70 °C for 15 minutes, shaking gently every 5 minutes using a thermomixer.
Centrifuge at 16000 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant and wash the nucleic acid pellet with ice-cold 70% ethanol, then let it dry.
Dissolve the nucleic acid pellet in 150 µL of elution buffer from the kit.
Transfer 1 mL of the supernatant to a new 2 mL Eppendorf tube, add an equal volume of ice-cold isopropanol, mix well, and incubate on ice for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge at 16000 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.
Discard the flow-through, add 500 µL of Buffer GW2, and centrifuge at 15000 x g, Room temperature, for 1 minute.

steps.title: Prepare PCR Mastermix
steps.instruction: Prepare the Q5 reaction buffer mix with the following components for one 40 µL reaction:

substeps.instruction: 5x Q5 reaction buffer: 10 µL
10 mM dNTPs: 1 µL
Forward primer: 2.5 µL
Reverse primer: 2.5 µL
Q5 HiFi DNA polymerase: 0.5 µL
ddH2O: 28.5 µL

steps.title: Perform 16S rRNA Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the 16S small subunit ribosomal RNA fragments.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 40 µL Mastermix into every PCR tube/well, then add 2 µL of template.
Seal the individual reaction tubes.
Perform PCR with settings: 95 °C for 3 minutes; 35 cycles of (95 °C for 30s, 55 °C for 30s, 72 °C for 30s); final extension at 72 °C for 5 minutes; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Clean Amplicons with AMPure XP Beads
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR products using magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex AMPure XP beads for 30 seconds and transfer the appropriate volume to a reagent reservoir.
Using a multichannel pipette, add 20 µL of beads to each well of the amplicon PCR plate.
Seal the plate and shake at 1800 rpm, Room temperature, for 2 minutes in the Thermomixer.
Incubate at Room temperature without shaking for 5 minutes.
Place the plate on a magnetic stand for 2 minutes or until the supernatant has cleared.
Remove and discard the supernatant using a multichannel pipette.
Wash beads with 200 µL of freshly prepared 80% ethanol; incubate on the magnetic stand for 30 seconds, then discard the supernatant.
Perform a second ethanol wash with 200 µL of 80% ethanol; incubate on the magnetic stand for 30 seconds, then discard the supernatant.
Centrifuge the amplicon PCR plate at 1000 x g, 20 °C, for 1 minute to collect condensate, remove the seal, and air-dry for 10 minutes or until ethanol has evaporated.

steps.title: Elute Purified DNA
steps.instruction: Recover the purified DNA from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Remove the plate from the magnetic stand and add 52.5 µL of 10 mM Tris pH 8.5 to each well.
Seal the plate and shake at 1800 rpm, Room temperature, for 2 minutes to resuspend beads.
Incubate at Room temperature for 2 minutes.
Place the plate on the magnetic stand for 2 minutes or until the supernatant has cleared.
Transfer 50 µL of the supernatant to a new 96-well PCR plate.

steps.title: Quantify and Dilute DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using Nanodrop1000 and dilute samples to 20 ng/µL as needed.

steps.title: Verify DNA via Agarose Gel
steps.instruction: Run an agarose gel to verify the samples.

substeps.instruction: Prepare gel by boiling 0.4 g of agarose in 50 mL TAE Buffer (refill evaporated water).
Add 1 µL of GelRed, pour into mold, insert comb, and let cool.
Mix DNA samples with gel loading dye (5 parts DNA to 1 part dye).
Load 2 µL of each sample per well and include 5 µL of 1 kbp ladder.
Run the gel at 80 V for 1 hour.

steps.title: Additional Column Purification
steps.instruction: Perform an additional purification step using ExtractMe columns.

substeps.instruction: Add 15 µL of proteinase K and 250 µL of Buffer GL, mix well, and incubate at 55 °C for 10 minutes (vortex every 60s).
Add 400 µL of GB-Buffer, mix well, and centrifuge at 16000 x g for 1 minute.
Transfer the supernatant to an ExtractMe column and centrifuge at 16000 x g for 1 minute.
Discard flow-through, add 600 µL of Buffer GW1, and centrifuge at 15000 x g, Room temperature, for 1 minute.
Discard flow-through and dry the column by centrifugation at 15000 x g, Room temperature, for 1 minute.
Transfer the column to a new Eppendorf tube, add 200 µL of warm Elution Buffer, and incubate at Room temperature for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 15000 x g, Room temperature, for 1 minute to elute the DNA.

steps.title: Sequencing
steps.instruction: Send the tubes to an external sequencing service.
